reason: I can't tell from photos whether a paper cloud pendant is actually well made, and I'd screenshot it and find near-identical ones on Amazon or Wayfair for a fraction of $360. A store I've never heard of with almost no reviews isn't enough to make me skip that comparison, even with free returns.
objection: It looks like a lookalike I can find cheaper elsewhere, and I have no way to judge the real material and finish from photos from a brand with hardly any reviews.
would_change_my_mind: A cheap sample of the shade material, or clear real-life photos and video from verified buyers showing the finish, plus proof it isn't the same item sold under other names for much less.
